description: Source code defining classes and methods for extracting and processing SEC management discussion and analysis filings, including query parameter configuration, data fetching, and content parsing with HTML and table handling.

classes.name: SecManagementDiscussionAnalysisQueryParams
classes.description: Extends query parameters for SEC management discussion analysis, adding options for extraction strategy, table inclusion, cache usage, and raw HTML output.

classes.name: SecManagementDiscussionAnalysisData
classes.description: Data class representing the extracted SEC management discussion and analysis content, including the source URL.

classes.name: SecManagementDiscussionAnalysisFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class providing static methods to transform queries, extract data asynchronously from SEC filings, and process the content with HTML and table parsing.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a strongly typed query parameter object.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches SEC filings, determines the correct filing URL, retrieves content with caching, and returns structured data including the content.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Processes raw HTML content, extracts and cleans text, handles tables and formatting, and structures the final text output.
